stories.label: Request form
stories.what: Site contacts send a request with a site, a contact and a problem type.

stories.label: Duplicate check
stories.what: A second open request for the same site and problem type is blocked.
stories.interim: Coordinators search open requests before booking.

stories.label: Region queues
stories.what: Each new request lands in its region's coordinator queue.

stories.label: Technician calendar
stories.what: Coordinators see booked and free slots for each technician.

stories.label: Book from the request
stories.what: The coordinator books a free slot and the visit keeps the request's history.

stories.label: Close with work notes
stories.what: Technicians record work notes on their phone before closing.

stories.label: Technician training
stories.what: Technicians learn the phone closeout before go-live.

stories.label: Customer survey
stories.what: Site contacts rate the visit after it closes.
